subject: Encryption evidence handoff + operator segregation for HarborTech
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@harbortech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@harbortech.com
Date: 2027-05-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Encryption evidence request and operator separation

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks for taking this on. HarborTech is moving toward a formal SOC 2 readiness review and our audit team has asked for a compact evidence bundle focused on encryption and key management for the tenant we will onboard (tenant: ht-prodn). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following artifacts and an estimated delivery timeline?

Requested items (we need a small sampling, not full dumps):
- KEK/DEK rotation manifest for last 90 days (timestamps + rollover events)
- Envelope key wrapping logs showing wrap/unwrap events (sample 30-day window)
- HSM attestation statement for the hardware that performed wrap operations (if using external HSM)
- Operator separation / role matrix (who can perform rotations, who signs operator actions)
- Transit protections evidence (TLS ciphers, mTLS endpoints used for tenant traffic)
- A short narrative describing BYOK/tenant-derived key handling and tokenization behavior for PII (how DEKs are derived/wrapped)

Also, we need to understand the delivery mechanism (SFTP, encrypted Drive link, or a secure ticket). Can you please reply with an intake checklist and an estimated date by EOW (end of week)?

Appreciate it — we are targeting the audit kickoff on 2027-05-20.

Best,
Alyssa Park
Senior InfoSec Manager | HarborTech
alyssa.park@harbortech.com

Attachment: none (request list above)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@harbortech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence request and operator separation

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a sampled bundle that meets the items you outlined. High-level intake plan below; Marissa (cc'd) will own the technical artifacts. Ben will coordinate delivery and any contract-level approvals.

Planned artifacts and approach:
- Rotation manifest (KEK + DEK): provide a CSV with rotation events for the last 90 days (we will redact tenant identifiers except ht-prodn).
- Envelope wrap/unwrap: 30-day sample of wrap/unwrap events (timestamps, key IDs, wrapping algorithm).
- HSM attestation: PDF attestation from our HSM vendor where applicable; if using cloud-managed KMS we will include FIPS/HSM mode statement.
- Operator separation: we will provide an XLSX matrix showing role names, principal IDs, and allowed actions (we will redact internal email aliases if needed).
- Transit: TLS configuration snapshot and mTLS endpoint certificate chain for the tenant ingress.
- Narrative: 1–2 page explanation outlining tenant-derived key derivation, envelope encryption, tokenization behavior, and recommended redaction guidance for audit use.

Delivery options: SFTP to a HarborTech-managed bucket (we can push), or a temporary encrypted Drive folder (we will PGP encrypt the archive if requested).

Target dates:
- Technical bundle (sample CSVs and matrix): 2027-05-11
- HSM attestation & narrative: 2027-05-13
- Final packaged archive and delivery: 2027-05-14

Please confirm that timeline works and whether you prefer SFTP (we will need access details) or encrypted Drive. Also let us know if HarborTech requires an NDA addendum for the raw logs.

Thanks — will stand up a secure folder and share links once we have your preference.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: intake-checklist-template.xlsx (will attach final)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@harbortech.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence request and operator separation

Vanessa / Ben / Alyssa — I pulled together the technical artifact plan and sampling rules. Details below so HarborTech's audit team can validate scope.

What we'll provide (technical specifics):
1) Rotation manifest (CSV): columns = event_time (ISO8601), tenant_id (redacted to ht-prodn), key_role (KEK/DEK), key_id, operation (create/rotate/deprecate), actor_principal (redacted to role: kms-operator-#), ticket_ref (internal ID). We will include a 90-day window and anonymize operator principal to role granularity. Sample file: harbortech-rotation-sample.csv

2) Envelope wrapping logs (30-day sample): will include wrap_id, wrapped_key_id, wrapping_algorithm (RSA-OAEP-256 / AES-KW), wrap_time, unwrap_time (if applicable), HSM_slot_id (or cloud-kms-region) and requester_role. We will exclude plaintext KEKs and will not provide actual key material.

3) HSM attestation: For hardware-backed wraps we will include a vendor-signed attestation PDF (hsm-attestation-statement.pdf). If the tenant used our software-only path (tenant-ephemeral), we will include the FIPS/validation statements for the keystore provider.

4) Operator separation matrix: XLSX (redwood-kms-operator-matrix.xlsx) that shows roles: admin, kms-operator, auditor; allowed actions include: rotate-key, approve-rotation, emergency-unwrap. We will include the change-control ticket references for any rotations in sample.

5) Transit proof: TLS cipher list, cert chain snapshots, and a short mTLS flow diagram. We will include the ingress endpoint fingerprints for ht-prodn.

6) Narrative: short doc that explains BYOK handshake (customer key import -> envelope wrap under KEK -> per-tenant DEK derivation), tokenization note (we can confirm that tokens are derived using tenant-specific salts and never reverse-mapped without a DEK unwrap).

Redaction & sampling: We will strip user-level PII from logs and replace with stable pseudonyms for traceability. For audit linking, we will include internal ticket IDs and a mapping file which can be shared under NDA.

Delivery & encryption options: We recommend a two-step delivery: (1) upload to a HarborTech SFTP endpoint using SCP with server-hostkey verification (you provide hostkey), (2) deliver the passphrase via a DocuSign-encrypted secret or a separate zipped PGP-encrypted file. If HarbourTech prefers, we can provision a temporary Azure Blob with SAS tokens.

Open questions for HarborTech audit team:
- Confirm acceptable redaction level (tenant-only vs tenant+user pseudonyms).
- Confirm transfer mechanism preference (SFTP vs encrypted Drive).
- Confirm whether an NDA addendum is required for ticket-level references.

I will assemble the sample files and upload to a staging folder once we confirm transfer method.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: none (referenced files will be attached in the package)

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@harbortech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, security@harbortech.com
Date: 2027-05-07T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence request and operator separation

Marissa / Vanessa — this is great, thanks for the level of detail. A few quick items to confirm so we can sign off with our auditors: 

- Redaction: HarborTech requires tenant-only redaction (ht-prodn) + stable pseudonyms for any operator role. Ticket refs are OK, but please redact internal staff emails.
- Delivery: SFTP works — we will provision a temporary endpoint and share hostkey and account details by EOD today. Please SCP the archive and send the PGP passphrase via DocuSign or the HubSpot secure note (we will accept either).
- NDA: we do not need an NDA addendum for the sampled artifacts, standard MSA covers this.

One clarifying question: can you confirm where tokenization happens in the flow (app-side vs Redwood runtime) and whether tokens can be reversed without a DEK unwrap? Our auditors specifically want a short, signed statement on that.

If you can include that paragraph in the narrative and bundle the operator matrix, rotation CSV, and the HSM attestation PDF in the package, we're good to proceed. Target: please upload by 2027-05-14 per Vanessa's timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to the upload details.

Best regards,
Alyssa Park
Senior InfoSec Manager | HarborTech
alyssa.park@harbortech.com
